change: Repeated the bounded thread stress at 1024 and instrumented a 16-thread sample under the same 512 MiB test limit.
evidence: The 1024-thread attempt aborted with a glibc TLS allocation error; the 16-thread sample reported VmSize growing from 71,396 KiB to 466,876 KiB. The latter deliberately fails an assertion to expose its measurements.
hypothesis: glibc per-thread allocator arenas can consume substantially more virtual memory than the nominal 128 KiB stack, increasing resource-exhaustion risk.
next_action: Exercise the retained server's accept/spawn/read pattern with incomplete sockets under the same sandbox limit.
verdict: The simplified stress test suggests a severe resource-pressure mechanism, not yet a complete end-to-end server reproduction.
